rows.en: Whoa!? They got my legs pinned too!
Hoi hoi! Hoiii!
Execute the two of them!
So it was a trap…
I wanted to eat that tasty curry just one more time! Namu Amida Butsu, Namu Amida Butsu…
Fire!
Hoiiii!?

Huh, huh!? The ones doin' the killin' are the ones dead.

Now what… kinda riddle is this?
Do you understand?
Iron Mask!? What's the meaning of this?
I am the one who will kill you! That is why I saved you.
Whaddaya mean? Throws us in a trap, then saves us so he can kill us again… Now that's one tough riddle!
Curse you, Iron Mask, getting in my way!
Heh heh heh… Where are your friends?
Right here!
Hm! Curse you…
Nngh!
Toya!
It seems the time has finally come to settle this, Gorenger! At them!
Hoi hoi! Hoi hoi, hoi!
Let's go!
Hmph, so some meddlers have shown up! Then I too will…
How about this!? I, Iron Mask, will defeat Gorenger! Now, can you keep up with me?
Guh! Not yet…!
Hmm… If he stays alive, my position here is finished! Use the Fire Seven!
Nuoooooh!? Curse you, Volcano Mask, nuguoh!
Stepped on the weapon he set himself, didn't he? That's divine punishment!
Stepped on the weapon he set himself, didn't he? That's divine punishment!
That's the end of Iron Mask General Temujin…
Not yet, Gorenger! It's not over yet!
…!? He's a general, all right… He's indestructible!
…Momo, Gorenger Storm!
Okay!
Freezing Device!
What!? The Gorenger Storm…!
It's frozen… stuck to Iron Mask's shoulder!?

I get it, it's the Freezing Device!

That thing that freezes any object in an instant and sticks it to him!
Heh heh heh heh… Hmph!
Guh… Damn you, Iron Mask!
Iron Mask Temujin is victorious!
Ah, no! Variblune!!
Wait! Once the frozen Gorenger Storm thaws, it'll explode!
What's that guy fixin' to do?
He means to ram us, Variblune and all!
Get on your machines! Hurry!
Your Excellency, behold. As I promised, I, Iron Mask Temujin… will now ram Gorenger!
Here he comes!
We can't get away!
Ao, now!
Right! Auto Controllerrr! Variblune, turn around!
Nuoh!? What is happening!?
The temperature inside is rising!
The ice is meltin'!
Nuooooooh!?
Variblune!!
…Variblune.

Iron Mask, I have seen your pride! Taking Variblune down with you was well done. Splendid!

Volcano Mask General Magman! Iron Mask General Temujin has died an honorable death in battle…
I shall crush the remaining Gorenger without fail, and you shall see it.
This is… Varidreen, the fortress of the sky that replaces Variblune.
Varidreen?
And that is the all-purpose tank, Varitank!
Varitank, huh…
Varidreen and Varitank… Now that's mighty reassuring!
Geez… You're such an opportunist!
Varidreen, a new fortress of the sky to replace Variblune, and the all-purpose tank Varitank were developed by EAGLE's scientists.
And now, at last, a fierce battle begins between Gorenger and the second commander, Volcano Mask.
Gather the five powers into one, and protect the world, Gorengerrr!
Kuh… That's impossible…!?
Defeat all of Kelbaan's forces!
Defeat all Zolder Soldiers!
Defeat Iron Mask General Temujin and the entire Black Cross Army!
Defeat Iron Mask General Temujin, the Black Cross Army and Gigant!
Variblune is destroyed or Shinmei is defeated
<c3>Kotaro Minami</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Kotaro Minami</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
Everyone's HP was cut in <c1>half</c>!!
Nobuhiko, son of Soichiro Akizuki, was born 19 years ago on the day of a solar eclipse.
At the same moment, his close friend Minami also had a son born to him: Kotaro.
When Kotaro lost his parents in a traffic accident, Soichiro Akizuki took him in. Kotaro was 3 years old at the time.
From then on, Kotaro was raised as Nobuhiko's brother, without any distinction between them.

uncertain: U06662: ナンマンダブ rendered "Namu Amida Butsu" (Buddhist prayer for the dead).
U06688: Momorenger's さすが将軍、不死身だわ rendered as grudging admiration.
U06712: バリブルゥゥ～ンッ!! drawn-out cry rendered plainly "Variblune!!" (stretched spelling would obscure the name).
U06726: ケルバーンを全て倒せ rendered "all of Kelbaan's forces" (Kelbaan is a saucer fleet).
U06735: 彼の親友の南 — "his" taken as Soichiro Akizuki's friend.
U06734/U06735: ruby readings in ［信彦（のぶひこ）］ dropped, names given once.

glyph_suspects.likely: 分け隔てなく育てられて
